svg.title: Card Validation Agent — process flow
svg.desc: Per-request flow from one or two card photos to ACCEPT, REVIEW or REJECT with early exits.
svg.text: Card Validation Agent — request process flow
1–2 photos of one card in (front / back) → one JSON decision out. Exits on the right.
jpeg / png / webp · ≤ 8 MB each · ≤ 2 photos
+ issue codes (or INVALID_IMAGE if not decodable)
PaddleOCR · 0° and 180° · text pooled across photos
DINOv2 vector · ORB keypoints · Lab body colour
Qdrant top-20 references ∪ keyword inverted index
ORB + RANSAC on ≤ 24 refs (front and back) → inliers
text · embedding · geometry · colour · fused over photos
each photo strongly matches another family
match to front / back references + declared side
continue — that side's fields are not read
10 · Align each side to its reference
region OCR → full-text regex → local VLM*
+ RETAKE_REQUIRED if that side's photo was unusable
card, variant, fields, photos and checks returned
Every decision → JSON (schema 2.1) · run stored in Qdrant + photos in run_store (review queue, console) · PII-masked audit log · Prometheus metrics
POST /v1/cards/validate/stream runs the same flow and emits each step as a server-sent event.
* VLM is optional, self-hosted (Ollama), off by default; its output is re-checked by the same regex and always triggers REVIEW.
